messages:
Morgan: Quick sync from the authz postmortem  I want a tight list of owners and dates for rotations, audit backfills, and the proposed quarterly sweep. Keep replies short so we can paste into the doc.
Jamie: I'll take svc-cache and svc-search token rotations. ETA: 2026-03-29.
Luis: Found missing audit lines for svc-auth during the incident window. I can backfill if I get event-store access.
Harper: I can grant the minimal RBAC for the migration job, ping me the service account.
Priya: Proposal: add a token-health alert + weekly report. If failure_rate > 1.5% for 30m -> runbook.
SecBot: Automated scan results attached: `scan-2026-03-18.csv` flagged 4 stale tokens across prod clusters.
Jamie: Stale list excerpt: ```
["svc-cache:stale-2025-12", "svc-search:rot-pending", "billing-adapter:oldkey", "metrics-proxy:legacy"]
```
Luis: I'll own audit backfill for svc-auth and billing-adapter. Est: 2 days once I have access (2026-03-30).
Harper: RBAC granted to `migration-runner@infra`. I'll DM creds rotation plan.
Morgan: Action items (compact): 1) rotate svc-cache + svc-search - Jamie - 2026-03-29; 2) rotate billing-adapter + metrics-proxy - Morgan/infra - 2026-03-31; 3) audit backfill for svc-auth & billing-adapter - Luis - 2026-03-30; 4) token-health alert + dashboard - Priya - 2026-04-03; 5) quarterly sweep schedule + owner map - Jamie - 2026-04-20.
Priya: Also adding a simple SLO: token_validation_success >= 98% over 24h. Will add to docs.
Jamie: I'll open PR for the rotation checklist and include `--dry-run` steps. Link when ready: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/????
Morgan: Can someone post a short kill-switch snippet in the runbook? Oncall must be able to revoke specific service tokens quickly.
Harper: Runbook snippet (staging test planned): ```
# revoke token dry-run
revoke --service svc-cache --id <token> --dry
# force revoke
revoke --service svc-cache --id <token> --now
```
SecBot: Reminder: follow-up checkpoint scheduled 2026-03-31 14:00 UTC.
Luis: Ack. Will start backfill job after RBAC.
Jamie: Ack. I'll coordinate rotation windows with infra to avoid rolling restarts during peak.
Morgan: Thanks. Please paste PR and runbook links into the postmortem doc when done. If blockers, ping me or @Priya. :white_check_mark:
